product_one_liner.value: SiteVue AI uses mounted and wearable cameras with real-time video analytics to turn work on plant floors and job sites into cycle-time, labor, throughput, quality, and safety insights for manufacturers, processors, and builders.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage footer has no pricing link. An industry-page FAQ gives only a subscription/quote model and directs prospective customers to request an exact quote; it is not a dedicated public pricing page.

named_customers.notes: Both are identified in customer testimonials on the company homepage.

employee_band.notes: The company reported 37 employees in its August 2026 announcement, which falls in this band.

hq_location.notes: The company LinkedIn profile lists headquarters in Franklin, Tennessee.

founded_year.notes: The company announcement describes SiteVue AI as founded in August 2025.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index describes deployment stories and operational insights for manufacturing leaders; it did not show engineering or technical build posts.

public_docs.notes: The homepage navigation/footer offers Press, Careers, and Contact, but no product documentation, help center, or developer portal link.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The official careers page is a Coming Soon placeholder and lists no open roles.

model_provider.value: SiteVue's own custom-trained, in-house AI models; it does not publicly name an external model provider.
model_provider.notes: The cited source says SiteVue trains its own AI models; it does not identify a third-party model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: I did not find a qualifying public SiteVue AI trust, security, or legal page or footer certification area naming any of the listed certifications, so I cannot distinguish an unclaimed certification from an undiscovered one.

last_funding.notes: The latest round identified was the $7.5 million seed round announced August 6, 2026.

raised_18mo.notes: The $7.5 million seed round was announced on 2026-08-06, within the 18 months before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The official careers page is a Coming Soon placeholder and lists no SDR, BDR, or account-executive opening.

launched_6mo.notes: A product-launch entry dated August 6, 2026 falls within the six months before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The roster identifies a CEO and a VP of Operations but supplies no appointment dates, and I found no dated qualifying departure; a C-level or VP-level change in the window cannot be confirmed or ruled out.

crm_stack_signal.notes: No readable job posts, product documentation, or integrations page was found from which to verify CRM or sales/marketing systems.
